goal: Create a network scanning tool that can discover devices and their open ports on a network
acceptance_criteria: The tool must support scanning individual hosts or CIDR ranges
The tool must support specifying port ranges to scan
The tool must handle timeouts appropriately for slow or unresponsive hosts
The tool must output results in JSON format
All network scanning functions (scan_port, resolve_host, scan_network) are properly exported and accessible
Comprehensive test suite passes with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
